items.claim: FAQ never says where the zsh lines go relative to compinit; sourcing before compinit still errors at every shell startup
items.consequence: If compdef is not defined, the new guard falls through to calling `_rg "$@"` outside a completion context. That means `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` placed before compinit prints an error on every shell start and registers no completion. It is the same class of failure issue #2956 reports, just triggered by line order. The new fpath instruction has the mirror-image problem: if `fpath=(...)` is added after compinit (common when users append to an oh-my-zsh .zshrc), completion is simply absent and nothing reports an error. The FAQ gives neither ordering constraint.
items.proposed_fix: In FAQ.md, say that `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` must come after `autoload -U compinit && compinit` (or after the framework line that runs compinit, e.g. oh-my-zsh), and that `fpath=($HOME/.zsh-complete $fpath)` must come before compinit. Optional hardening in rg.zsh (assumes ci/test-complete is the only caller that intentionally sources without compsys): key the direct-call branch on `$funcstack[1] == _rg` or `$_RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS`, and when compdef is missing print a one-line 'load compinit first' message instead of calling _rg.

FAQ.md:132-135 -- Or if you'd prefer to load and generate completions at the same time, you can add the following to your `$HOME/.zshrc` file: ... source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
FAQ.md:128 -- fpath=($HOME/.zsh-complete $fpath)
Scratch zsh 5.8.1: `zsh -f -c 'source <(cat rg.zsh)'` without compinit -> `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments`, rc=1; after `compinit` -> rc=0 and `_comps[rg]=_rg`.

items.claim: FAQ .zshrc snippet for the source method keeps the `$ ` prompt, so pasting it runs a `$` command
items.consequence: The block is introduced as text to add to $HOME/.zshrc, not as a command to type at a prompt. Pasting it verbatim gives `zsh: command not found: $` (exit 127) on every shell start, and completion is not registered by that line.
items.proposed_fix: Change FAQ.md:135 to `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` (no leading `$ `), matching the prompt-less fpath snippet at FAQ.md:128.

native_payload.intent: Make `rg --generate complete-zsh` output usable when sourced directly (`source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`). When not autoloaded as `_rg` and compsys is present, it registers `compdef _rg rg` instead of calling `_rg`. The fpath-autoload path and ci/test-complete keep working. The FAQ zsh section gains the missing fpath step and documents the source alternative with a startup-cost caveat.

residual_risks: ci/test-complete works only because compdef is undefined in the shell it runs in. It sources rg.zsh from a non-interactive zsh that still reads /etc/zshenv and ~/.zshenv. If either runs compinit, the script takes the `compdef _rg rg` branch, dumps no specs, and the harness fails loudly with 'Failed to get comp_args'. This is a loud failure, not a silent pass. (adversarial)

An empty funcstack combined with NO_UNSET makes `$funcstack[1]` error (`parameter not set`). This only happens when the file is executed as a top-level script under `zsh -o nounset`. `source` and `eval` at top level both push an entry onto funcstack and were verified to work with nounset. It is not a realistic usage path. (correctness)
testing_gaps: No automated test covers the new `compdef _rg rg` branch. ci/test-complete only exercises the no-compsys direct-call branch. It was verified manually in scratch zsh 5.8.1: source after compinit, eval after compinit, and fpath autoload all register `_rg`, and an interactive zpty session completed `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>` to `complete-zsh` under both the fpath and source setups. The base version reproduces the #2956 error when sourced.

Agreement with it counts as corroboration, not cross-model verification, so no confidence was promoted.
